System for pharmacy chains

Stock, expiry dates and marking codes in every pharmacy under control, with near-expiry medicines moved to another branch in time. Qilich builds the MVP in 10–14 weeks, from UZS 215 mln; the full version in 20–32 weeks.

Questions

What does “System for pharmacy chains” cost?
At Qilich the MVP costs $18,000–35,000 (UZS 215–425 mln) and the full version $45,000–100,000 (UZS 540–1,205 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “System for pharmacy chains” take?
Qilich builds the MVP in 10–14 weeks and the full version in 20–32 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “System for pharmacy chains”?
How the work runs today and sample documents; existing data: Excel or an old system; staff to try the system; one person who makes the decisions.
